text:
tim: Proposal: add a small "retry reservation" slot on ingress to hold capacity for a retry in-flight instead of letting retries compete with new requests when upstream is congested.
alex: quick sketch? worried about leaking slots if client disappears.
raj: +1 on controlling retry admission. can you outline how it's charged/billed?
marta: thinking: two flavors — per-tenant reserved slots vs a global pool. per-tenant avoids noisy neighbor retries.
tim: sketch: keep N slots per route (default 1). when gateway accepts a request it may allocate 0..M reservation slots depending on `max_retries` and route policy. if upstream fails, gateway will use a reserved slot to re-enqueue the retry instantly rather than contend.
raj: how do we prevent slot hoarding? e.g., slow request occupies slot for many seconds.
sarah: slot TTL + soft preemption. if request passes X ms without progress, drop its reservation (and mark for backoff). also track by progress pulses (bytes/frames) for streaming.
alex: what about streaming? partial response then retry — we can't just replay stream easily.
tim: for streaming, reservation only buys a small window to attempt fallback to a cheaper variant or to route to a replica. it doesn't imply replaying body. we should gate reservation usage for streaming requests to idempotent streaming types only.
marta: config example:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: chat-stream
    retry_policy:
      retries: 2
      reservation_slots: 1
      slot_ttl_ms: 2000
      preempt_percentage: 10
```
alex: ok but metrics/billing — do we bill reserved capacity? If a tenant holds slot but never uses, they'd be unhappy.
raj: propose: reservation is free for first 500ms then counts toward concurrent capacity for billing. or bill only when a reservation is consumed.
sarah: prefer bill-on-consume. telemetry: emit events: reservation_acquired, reservation_expired, reservation_used, reservation_preempted.
ops-bot: deployment: canary of reservation-toggle flag rolled to 10% infra cluster at 1744456810 :rocket:
alex: failure modes — if upstream blackout + many retries queued, reservation could still lead to retry pileup. need global admission circuit that caps total retry inflight per cluster.
tim: agreed. plan: layered approach: per-route reservation + cluster-wide retry-capacity token bucket. reservation only guarantees soft chance to retry, not unlimited retries.
marta: API surface: SDK gets new header `X-Retry-Reserved: true|false` so downstreams know this was a reserved retry attempt.
raj: security: don't leak reservation behavior to third parties, header only internal via mTLS.
sarah: can someone write a short RFC follow-up with tradeoffs (billing, streaming edgecases, slot preemption algorithm)? add a simulation of heavy-tail p99 latencies vs reservation slots.
tim: I'll draft a short follow-up and drop it here. thanks for the quick callouts :thumbsup:
alex: please add a short perf test plan too (chaos test with upstream flaps).
